verdict.rationale: Elicit's Alerts feature lets users set up a rule ('new relevant paper found') that automatically triggers an action (instant email notification), which is a form of event-triggered automation, but this is the only such capability and is narrowly scoped to literature alerts rather than a general rule/action framework. Missing for 10: a general-purpose rules/automation engine, support for custom triggers beyond paper alerts, and evidence of user-defined conditional actions (e.g., webhooks, workflow triggers) beyond a single notification feature.
